Show HN: Baa – a menu bar app that frees RAM your AI agents forgot about
items.summary: i built this because my mac keeps running out of RAM every 2 hours and i typically get around it by closing random apps and hoping it will help. :') baa sits in the menu bar and: - finds stuff still eating memory after its app or terminal closed, or that ai agents started and forgot (dev servers, headless browsers) - shows how much you'd get back and frees it in one click - warns you a few minutes before you run out - also finds dev junk on your disk (old builds, package caches etc.) open source and nothing leaves your machine. would love feedback! baa would've cleared ~50gb on my mac :)
